verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a broad API covering contacts, custom objects, webhooks and account info. Per-endpoint OpenAPI specs and an MCP server with read and write access to CRM data back this up. Nothing shows that UI-only features have API equivalents, including workflows, sequences, reporting dashboards, imports and deduplication; these appear only as UI knowledge-base docs. Missing for 10: documented API parity for workflows, sequences, reports/dashboards and import/dedup; any explicit parity claim; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: To create one contact, make a `POST` request to `/crm/v3/objects/contacts`.
